THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My Ref. No.: 3/3/5/2/7. Ref. No. of Ministry of Lands.: 13/99/FR/386. I, have give notice that the Government intends to acquire the following land that necessary for a public purpose under Sub-section (1) of Section (7) of lands Acquisition Act which was amended as per the (amended) Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964.
Description of the land to be acquired: Acquiring of lands to the Government for Knuckles Conservation Zone is denoted as a public purpose in this effort.

Details of allotments No. 1 & 2 of land called Gonamadawatta that shown in Surveyor General’s approved Plan No. F. V. P. 1707 and dated 11.09.2017 situated in Pitawala village in the E-385 of Pitawala GN Division in Laggala Udasiya Pattu in Laggala DS Division, Matale District of Central Province are contained total extent of 12.3070.
Total extents of the allotments are 5.7372 Hec. Which were included the Lot No. 8497, 8499, 8500, 8503 and 8504.
01. Lot No. 01 Name of land: Gonamada watta; Name and Address of Claimant: Chulanath Prasanjith Rathwatte, No. 40, Wattaranternna Rd, Kandy; Description: Scrub Jungle; Extent: 11.8959 Hectares.
02. Lot No. 02 Name of land: Gonamada watta; Name and Address of Claimant: Chulanath Prasanjith Rathwatte, No. 40, Wattarantenna; Description: Scrub Jungle; Extent: 0.4111 Hectare.
All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agents before me at 10.00 a. m. on the 27th day of June 2019 at the Laggala Divisional Secretariat.

And further, you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 19th June 2019, nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims of compensation, for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the compensation of such amount.
S. D. P. JAYASOORIYA, Divisional Secretary, Laggala Division. On 15th May 2019, At Divisional Secretary’s Office-Laggala. 06-165/1
